name: Radox AI
description: 33 models with a 0.5M-token monthly free allowance and no card.
overview: Radox AI runs the same catalogue as Clean APIs on its own domain: Claude Fable 5, GPT-5.6 Luna, DeepSeek V4 Flash and Pro, Qwen3.8 27B, Seed 2.1 Turbo and 27 more behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint at radoxai.com/v1. A separate account grants its own 500,000 free tokens a month with no card, and the free plan reaches every model, so the allowance can go on a frontier model. Paid plans start at $4.50 for 100M tokens, with balance-based overage at list rates.
free_access: 500K free tokens every month, per account
No card; all 33 models on the free plan
OpenAI-compatible with streaming, tools and vision
Overage bills at list rates, HTTP 402 when empty
notes: Same catalogue and dashboard as cleanapis.com and oxionai.com, but a separate account and a separate monthly allowance. Pricing differs slightly: 100M tokens is $4.50 here, $3.50 on Clean APIs.
